quarantined_leads.lead: Former Hall County Sheriff's Office lieutenant Michael Todd Casper (also identified in the image caption as Todd Caspar) was reported to have resigned while under an internal-affairs investigation after investigators sustained findings involving personal sexual communications, lewd conduct in a work office and patrol vehicle, dishonesty, and misuse of county time and resources.
quarantined_leads.source_title: Hall County lieutenant resigns amid accusations of on-duty misconduct, resource misuse
quarantined_leads.subject_response: Casper acknowledged kissing and hugging the woman, exchanging nude photographs, and sending at least one nude photograph from his work office while in uniform and on duty; he disputed some evidence as possibly fabricated or manipulated by artificial intelligence. He resigned on July 30 while under investigation. The original harassment allegation was not sustained; the reported internal-affairs findings concerned other policy violations.
quarantined_leads.reason: The report is a single in-window local-news account of an administrative investigation whose underlying resignation occurred July 30 and whose case was closed August 13. It does not document an explicit Republican, conservative, right-wing, or qualifying affiliated-organizational role beyond public employment in a sheriff's office. The matter is retained for follow-up, but no event is published under the affiliation gate and single-report evidence boundary. The reported findings and Casper's response are not treated as a criminal conviction or universal adjudication of every allegation.
